name: What is the process for attic insulation replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for attic insulation replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a thorough inspection of your existing attic and insulation to assess its condition and R-value. If old insulation needs removal, specialized vacuums are used. Next, any air leaks in the attic floor are sealed to prevent conditioned air from escaping. Finally, the new insulation, whether blown-in, batt, or spray foam, is installed to the recommended R-value, ensuring even coverage and proper ventilation. The area is then cleaned, completing the upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, old insulation removal (if needed), air sealing, new insulation installation, and cleanup.
